newsitem.title: UK: UK gilts dip 1/2 point on profit-taking,trade thin.
newsitem.headline: UK gilts dip 1/2 point on profit-taking,trade thin.

text.p: 0730 GMT - LIFFE June gilts doubled early losses and were around 1/2 point lower as profit-taking kicked in following confirmation of a Labour victory in the May 1 election, erasing latent fears of hung parliament. Dealers say trade thin before U.S. data due 1230 GMT. LIFFE June gilts down 16/32 at 110-9/32
